default.notes: Apply for a visa before travel through a Bangladeshi embassy or high commission, starting the application on the official portal visa.gov.bd.

groups.notes: Visa-free under bilateral exemption agreements, generally for up to 90 days — confirm the exact allowance with a Bangladeshi mission before travel.

30-day visa on arrival (about US$51, cash) at Dhaka and other international airports for tourism and short business visits — issued at officers' discretion, so carry a return ticket and hotel details, and confirm eligibility with your airline before flying.

BD.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for Bangladeshi citizens.

IL.notes: Bangladesh does not recognise Israel and Israeli passport holders are refused entry.

IN.notes: Indian citizens are not eligible for the visa on arrival — apply in advance at a Bangladeshi mission in India, and allow extra time for processing.
